description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files to find violations related to channel-agnostic boundaries, such as improper imports, config references, or literal channel identifiers. It primarily serves as a static analysis tool to enforce architectural constraints within the codebase.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes source code content to identify violations where channel-specific code leaks into channel-agnostic parts, such as inappropriate module imports, references to 'channels' in config paths, channel comparisons, or channel assignments with literals.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Wrapper around 'findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations' to check only module specifiers, ignoring config references, used for reverse dependency checks in channel core.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Detects user-facing text literals that reference channel names without proper module specifier context, ensuring UI text does not inappropriately embed channel identifiers.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Finds hardcoded system mark literals ('⚙️') in source code that should be avoided or managed properly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script that collects relevant files, runs all violation checks, and reports any issues found.
